AJAY KUMAR BYRI
VENDOR MANAGEMENT SPECIALIST 
ajaybyri1429@gmail.com   |   +91 7382197926   |   Visakhapatnam, A.P |  LinkedIn
PROFILE
Vendor Management and Procurement professional with 5.7 years of experience leading contract negotiation, vendor onboarding, category management, and spend analysis across service-based and product-based organizations. Proven track record in supplier performance management, contract lifecycle management, and stakeholder management, delivering measurable cost reductions and operational efficiency. Skilled in team leadership, SLA management, strategic sourcing, and ERP systems (SAP Ariba), with a strong background in demand forecasting and global sourcing.
CORE COMPETENCIES
Procurement Lead • Vendor Management • Category Management • Contract Lifecycle Management • Supplier Performance Management • Vendor Onboarding • Spend Analysis • Stakeholder Management • Team Leadership • SLA Management • Strategic Sourcing • RFP/RFQ/RFI • ERP Systems (SAP Ariba & BAAN)
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
· Led category management and supplier performance for 30% of revenue-generating suppliers, executing 4M reschedule/cancellation opportunities per quarter and reducing costs by 15% through non-compliance checks and CR leakage control.
· Delivered a 7% overall cost reduction through vendor negotiation on the GL Electrical Commodity category, earning Employee of the Month (Q3 2024).
· Managed pushout and cancellation of purchase orders as a key inventory KPI, pushing out 40% of POs and $5M in value while ensuring optimal inventory levels.
· Built the Vision 360 Tool with the automation team, saving 2 hours of individual time daily on entitlement and subscription tracking; also created a two-week shipment macro saving 45 hours of monthly time savings per employee.
· Recognized with four performance awards (FY24–FY25) for cross-functional workflow leadership, subscription/entitlement management, and sourcing strategy improvements.
WORK EXPERIENCE
Vendor Management – Senior Research Analyst   |   RR Donnelley (Client: Morgan Stanley) |   Aug 2024 – Present
· Led vendor management and contract lifecycle administration for 1,000+ subscriptions and contract renewals across EMEA, APAC, and AMERICAS for high-profile Financial Advisors.
· Served as QC Lead, providing team leadership for a team of 5 on the Entitlements process while meeting tight SLA-driven deadlines.
· Acted as a single point of contact (SPOC) for the Platinum service group, managing vendor onboarding and service setup for high-profile clients.
· Managed contract lifecycle and vendor compliance in partnership with the sourcing team, ensuring adherence to client requirements through cross-functional stakeholder management.
· Led vendor negotiations to secure favorable contract terms and partnered with vendors on complex agreement management to meet client requirements.
· Delivered financial reporting on usage-based services, providing weekly spend analysis to management and leadership.
· Functioned as Workflow Coordinator, optimizing team workflow management and stakeholder communication to resolve a team crisis and meet business goals.
· Owned the Optimized Spend Tool and conducted monthly spend analysis on vendor usage reports, allocating expenses in alignment with service utilization for individual Financial Advisors.
· Facilitated AMEX/VISA statement of reconciliations, ensuring precise financial allocation of vendor charges.
· Processed vendor invoice management and payments via SAP Ariba and maintained the V360 Tracker for on-time contract renewals.
· Managed the Invoice Management Portal to resolve pending invoices and ensure timely payments, improving vendor relationship metrics.
Senior Procurement Analyst   |   Flextronics India Private Limited   |   Feb 2021 – Jul 2024
· Led procurement and category management for major automotive accounts (Nexteer, Webasto, BMW, FIA, Ford) across high-revenue sites, consistently delivering results on a quarterly basis.
· Ensured zero-line downtime in production by managing critical shortages for A, B, and C parts and performing root cause analysis for rapid resolution.
· Managed end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) process from PO issuance through on-time supplier payment, including status tracking and escalation in MRP.
· Owned category management and supplier performance evaluation for 30% of revenue-generating suppliers, driving new order placement decisions based on lead times, price, and flexibility.
· Reduced order-processing time by 10% by optimizing the process for clearing receiving challenges.
· Optimized Return to Vendor (RTV) process time by 15% through stakeholder management with MRB teams on defect analysis and RMA shipping.
· Led RFx processes (RFP, RFQ, RFI) and vendor selection, preparing documentation to meet budget and delivery goals during critical line-down situations.
· Managed core procurement processes for New Product Introduction (NPI) products transitioning to mass production.
SKILLS
· Software: SAP Ariba, BAAN, QuoteWin, MSTR, Optimized Spend, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook
· Hard Skills: Demand Forecasting, Demand Planning, Procurement, Purchasing, Financial Reconciliation, Procure-to-Pay Process, Category Management, Vendor Onboarding, Spend Analysis
· Techniques: Lean Six Sigma, Strategic Sourcing, Data Analysis, Continuous Improvement, Root Cause Analysis, Logistics Management, Invoice Management, Inventory Management, Vendor Management, Contract Lifecycle Management, Supplier Performance Management, Workflow Coordination
· Soft Skills: Team Leadership, Stakeholder Management, Negotiation, Communication, Time Management, Analytical Thinking, Conflict Resolution
CERTIFICATIONS
· Strategic Sourcing Certified
· Lean Management Certified
· Six Sigma White Belt Certified
· Vendor Management Certified
EDUCATION
· Indian Institute of Information Technology — Mechanical Engineering & Advanced Manufacturing, GPA 8.05
· Sri Chaitanya Junior College — MPC, 97%
